## Investment Recommendation

AAPL presents a BUY opportunity with strong fundamentals. Revenue growth of 8.2% YoY, ROE of 37.5%, and operating margin of 32.1%. DCF fair value: $245.00. Analyst price target: $230.00. Monte Carlo simulation indicates p10=$175.00, p50=$215.00, p90=$290.00.

## Valuation Analysis

Bull case: $290.00. Bear case: $175.00.

## Financial Performance

| Metric | Current | YoY Change |
|--------|---------|------------|
| Revenue | $391.0B | +8.2% |
| Net Income | $93.7B | +10.5% |
| Free Cash Flow | $87.5B | +7.1% |

## Key Risks

- Slowing iPhone upgrade cycle in mature markets
- Regulatory pressure on App Store commission structure
- Valuation premium vs historical averages

## Growth Opportunities

- Services revenue expansion (App Store, Apple Music, iCloud)
- Emerging market smartphone penetration in India and SE Asia
- Wearables and health ecosystem cross-selling
